findings: P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:266 | root cause: DeleteMapping only unmaps memory and leaves the suffix-keyed Vault enroll plus its committed operation identity intact, so a later CreateMapping of the same normalized suffix either replays that committed enroll or cannot enroll the deterministic secret_ref | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:29, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:67, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:525, testing/integration/cloudflare-dns/cloudflare_test.go:781, testing/integration/cloudflare-dns/mapping_test.go:157 | impact: after delete (or rename away from a created suffix), recreating that suffix resurrects the old Vault material when the client reuses the create operation key, or fails/pends on a new key because the hashed secret_ref still exists; new Token bytes are discarded | minimal fix: retire or rebind the suffix-owned Vault identity and stop treating a pre-delete mapping-create commit as a live mapping

P2[blocking]: plugins/cloudflare-dns/service.go:729 | root cause: Cancel nils service.mappings while in-flight Create/Share/Rename/Rotate writers still assign into that map under mu without a live/nil guard | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:145, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:192, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:474, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:519 | impact: generation revoke or Close during a mapping mutation panics instead of failing closed with ErrRevoked, and can prevent drain | minimal fix: swap in an empty map or reject writes when the service is unlive/mappings is unset under the same lock
result.summary: Local handle 已审完 4 页 diff 与相邻 Vault/authorize/revoke 实现；核对了 T-map-resolve 目标与 R1/R2/R4/R5/R6 可观察契约、后缀匹配、命中/未命中/兜底/映射 Token 失效、脱敏、授权拒绝、删除/轮换后解析、既有 DNS broker 回归与 recipe verify。发现两个仍有效根因：删除未退役后缀的耐久创建身份，以及 Cancel 把 mappings 置 nil 导致在途写 panic。
